**BACKEND SCHEMA**  
Writer’s Personal Website  
_Postgres (Supabase) tables, policies, functions and indexes_

1\. Conventions
===============

*   Database: PostgreSQL on Supabase. All objects live in the public schema unless noted.
*   Primary keys are uuid with gen\_random\_uuid(). Timestamps are timestamptz. Emails use citext (case-insensitive).
*   Constraints in the database come first: NOT NULL, CHECK, UNIQUE and foreign keys with deliberate ON DELETE behaviour. Application validation (Zod) repeats them for friendly messages but is never the only guard.
*   **RLS is enabled on every table.** Public readers see only published rows. Subscriber data has no public policy at all.
*   Migrations are forward-only, one file each, using expand → backfill → contract for any change to a live table. Indexes on live tables are created CONCURRENTLY in their own migration.
*   Lists use keyset pagination on (published\_at, id); SELECT \* is not used in application queries; body\_md is never selected for list screens.
*   Names: tables are plural snake\_case; enums are singular.

===================

| **Table** | **Purpose** | **Public read?** | **Requirements** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| posts | Poems, stories, reflections, quotes (kind) | Published rows only | FR-LIST-01, FR-READ-01/02, FR-QUOTE-01, FR-ADM-02/03 |
| books | Books | Published rows only | FR-BOOK-01, FR-ADM-04 |
| site\_settings | Singleton: title, tagline, author, About, links | Yes | FR-ABOUT-01, FR-ADM-05 |
| site\_admins | Which auth users are admins | No | FR-ADM-01 |
| subscribers | Email subscribers and their status | No | FR-SUB-01/02/03, FR-ADM-07 |
| notifications | Outbox: one row per piece to announce | No | FR-NTF-01/02/03 |
| notification\_deliveries | One row per (notification, subscriber) | No | FR-NTF-01/03, NFR-REL-01 |
| email\_events | Provider webhook events (bounce, complaint) | No | FR-NTF-03 |

3\. Types and extensions
========================

create extension if not exists citext;  
  
create type post\_kind as enum ('poem', 'story', 'reflection', 'quote');  
create type publish\_status as enum ('draft', 'published');  
create type book\_progress as enum ('upcoming', 'in\_progress', 'available');  
create type subscriber\_status as enum  
('pending', 'confirmed', 'unsubscribed', 'bounced', 'complained');  
create type delivery\_status as enum ('queued', 'sent', 'failed');

4\. Tables
==========

4.1 Helper functions
--------------------

create function set\_updated\_at() returns trigger  
language plpgsql as $$  
begin  
new.updated\_at := now();  
return new;  
end $$;  
  
\-- A piece keeps its first publish date forever, including after  
\-- unpublish and republish.  
create function stamp\_published\_at() returns trigger  
language plpgsql as $$  
begin  
if new.status = 'published' and new.published\_at is null then  
new.published\_at := now();  
end if;  
return new;  
end $$;

4.2 site\_admins
----------------

create table site\_admins (  
user\_id uuid primary key references auth.users (id) on delete cascade,  
created\_at timestamptz not null default now()  
);  
  
create function is\_admin() returns boolean  
language sql stable security definer set search\_path = public as $$  
select exists (  
select 1 from site\_admins where user\_id = (select auth.uid())  
);  
$$;  
_Public sign-up must be disabled in Supabase Auth settings. The single admin user is created by the developer at handover and inserted into_ site\_admins_._

4.3 site\_settings
------------------

create table site\_settings (  
id smallint primary key default 1 check (id = 1),  
site\_title text not null check (length(site\_title) between 1 and 120),  
tagline text check (length(tagline) <= 200),  
author\_name text not null check (length(author\_name) between 1 and 120),  
about\_md text not null default '' check (length(about\_md) <= 20000),  
about\_photo\_path text,  
about\_photo\_alt text,  
contact\_email text check (length(contact\_email) <= 254),  
social\_links jsonb not null default '\[\]'::jsonb  
check (jsonb\_typeof(social\_links) = 'array'),  
updated\_at timestamptz not null default now(),  
check (about\_photo\_path is null or about\_photo\_alt is not null)  
);  
  
create trigger site\_settings\_updated before update on site\_settings  
for each row execute function set\_updated\_at();  
social\_links holds an array of { "label": string, "url": "https://…" }; the shape is validated by Zod on write. The row is created by the seed migration and only ever updated.

4.4 posts
---------

create table posts (  
id uuid primary key default gen\_random\_uuid(),  
kind post\_kind not null,  
slug text not null  
check (slug ~ '^\[a-z0-9\]+(-\[a-z0-9\]+)\*$' and length(slug) <= 80),  
title text check (title is null or length(title) between 1 and 160),  
body\_md text not null check (length(body\_md) between 1 and 200000),  
excerpt text check (excerpt is null or length(excerpt) <= 300),  
attribution text check (attribution is null or length(attribution) <= 120),  
status publish\_status not null default 'draft',  
published\_at timestamptz,  
created\_at timestamptz not null default now(),  
updated\_at timestamptz not null default now(),  
  
unique (kind, slug),  
check (kind = 'quote' or title is not null), -- only quotes are untitled  
check (kind <> 'quote' or length(body\_md) <= 600), -- quotes are short  
check (kind = 'quote' or attribution is null), -- attribution is for quotes  
check (status = 'draft' or published\_at is not null)  
);  
  
create trigger posts\_stamp before insert or update on posts  
for each row execute function stamp\_published\_at();  
create trigger posts\_updated before update on posts  
for each row execute function set\_updated\_at();  
Trigger order: Postgres fires triggers alphabetically by name, so posts\_stamp runs before posts\_updated, and both run before the CHECK constraints are evaluated.

4.5 books
---------

create table books (  
id uuid primary key default gen\_random\_uuid(),  
slug text not null unique  
check (slug ~ '^\[a-z0-9\]+(-\[a-z0-9\]+)\*$' and length(slug) <= 80),  
title text not null check (length(title) between 1 and 160),  
subtitle text check (length(subtitle) <= 200),  
synopsis\_md text not null check (length(synopsis\_md) <= 20000),  
excerpt\_md text check (length(excerpt\_md) <= 50000),  
cover\_path text,  
cover\_alt text,  
progress book\_progress not null default 'upcoming',  
purchase\_url text check (purchase\_url is null or purchase\_url ~ '^https://'),  
release\_date date,  
sort\_order integer not null default 0,  
status publish\_status not null default 'draft',  
published\_at timestamptz,  
created\_at timestamptz not null default now(),  
updated\_at timestamptz not null default now(),  
  
check (cover\_path is null or cover\_alt is not null),  
check (status = 'draft' or published\_at is not null)  
);  
  
create trigger books\_stamp before insert or update on books  
for each row execute function stamp\_published\_at();  
create trigger books\_updated before update on books  
for each row execute function set\_updated\_at();

4.6 subscribers
---------------

create table subscribers (  
id uuid primary key default gen\_random\_uuid(),  
email citext not null unique check (length(email) <= 254),  
status subscriber\_status not null default 'pending',  
confirm\_token\_hash bytea, -- SHA-256 of the emailed token  
confirm\_expires\_at timestamptz,  
last\_confirm\_sent\_at timestamptz,  
consented\_at timestamptz not null default now(), -- form submitted  
confirmed\_at timestamptz,  
unsubscribed\_at timestamptz,  
source text not null default 'web'  
check (source in ('web', 'admin\_import')),  
created\_at timestamptz not null default now(),  
updated\_at timestamptz not null default now(),  
  
check (status <> 'confirmed' or confirmed\_at is not null),  
check (status <> 'unsubscribed' or unsubscribed\_at is not null),  
check (confirm\_token\_hash is null or confirm\_expires\_at is not null)  
);  
  
create unique index subscribers\_confirm\_token\_idx  
on subscribers (confirm\_token\_hash) where confirm\_token\_hash is not null;  
create index subscribers\_status\_idx on subscribers (status);  
  
create trigger subscribers\_updated before update on subscribers  
for each row execute function set\_updated\_at();

*   The unsubscribe token is **not stored**: it is id.HMAC\_SHA256(id, UNSUBSCRIBE\_HMAC\_SECRET) computed when each email is built and verified in constant time.
*   On confirm, confirm\_token\_hash and confirm\_expires\_at are set to null, so a token works once.
*   Unsubscribed, bounced and complained rows are kept so that an address is not mailed again by accident. On an erasure request the row is deleted permanently (FR-ADM-07).
*   An unsubscribed person who subscribes again returns to pending and must confirm again.

4.7 notifications and deliveries (outbox)
-----------------------------------------

create table notifications (  
id uuid primary key default gen\_random\_uuid(),  
post\_id uuid unique references posts (id) on delete cascade,  
book\_id uuid unique references books (id) on delete cascade,  
status text not null default 'pending'  
check (status in ('pending', 'processing', 'done', 'failed')),  
created\_at timestamptz not null default now(),  
completed\_at timestamptz,  
check (num\_nonnulls(post\_id, book\_id) = 1)  
);  
  
create table notification\_deliveries (  
id uuid primary key default gen\_random\_uuid(),  
notification\_id uuid not null references notifications (id) on delete cascade,  
subscriber\_id uuid not null references subscribers (id) on delete cascade,  
status delivery\_status not null default 'queued',  
provider\_message\_id text,  
attempts smallint not null default 0 check (attempts >= 0),  
last\_error text check (length(last\_error) <= 500),  
sent\_at timestamptz,  
created\_at timestamptz not null default now(),  
unique (notification\_id, subscriber\_id)  
);  
  
create index deliveries\_pending\_idx  
on notification\_deliveries (notification\_id, status)  
where status <> 'sent';  
create index deliveries\_subscriber\_idx  
on notification\_deliveries (subscriber\_id);

*   The two UNIQUE columns on notifications guarantee a piece can be announced **once, ever** (FR-NTF-02). A deleted piece takes its notification with it (cascade).
*   The (notification\_id, subscriber\_id) unique constraint makes the fan-out idempotent (NFR-REL-01).
*   Deleting a subscriber removes their delivery rows (cascade), which is what erasure requires.

4.8 email\_events
-----------------

create table email\_events (  
id uuid primary key default gen\_random\_uuid(),  
provider\_event\_id text not null unique, -- de-duplicates webhook retries  
type text not null check (length(type) <= 60),  
subscriber\_id uuid references subscribers (id) on delete set null,  
payload jsonb not null,  
received\_at timestamptz not null default now()  
);  
create index email\_events\_subscriber\_idx on email\_events (subscriber\_id);

5\. Publish functions (transactional)
=====================================

Publishing and recording the notification must succeed or fail together. These functions run as the database owner but check the caller is an admin first.  
create function publish\_post(p\_id uuid, p\_notify boolean default true)  
returns uuid  
language plpgsql security definer set search\_path = public as $$  
declare v\_notification uuid;  
begin  
if not is\_admin() then  
raise exception 'forbidden' using errcode = '42501';  
end if;  
  
update posts set status = 'published'  
where id = p\_id and status = 'draft';  
if not found then  
raise exception 'post not found or not a draft' using errcode = 'P0002';  
end if;  
  
if p\_notify then  
insert into notifications (post\_id) values (p\_id)  
on conflict (post\_id) do nothing  
returning id into v\_notification; -- null if one already existed  
end if;  
return v\_notification;  
end $$;  
  
revoke execute on function publish\_post(uuid, boolean) from public, anon;  
grant execute on function publish\_post(uuid, boolean) to authenticated;  
publish\_book(p\_id uuid, p\_notify boolean) is identical, operating on books and notifications.book\_id. The application enqueues the QStash job only when the function returns a notification id.

6\. Row Level Security
======================

alter table site\_admins enable row level security;  
alter table site\_settings enable row level security;  
alter table posts enable row level security;  
alter table books enable row level security;  
alter table subscribers enable row level security;  
alter table notifications enable row level security;  
alter table notification\_deliveries enable row level security;  
alter table email\_events enable row level security;  
  
\-- Public content  
create policy posts\_public\_read on posts  
for select to anon, authenticated using (status = 'published');  
create policy posts\_admin\_all on posts  
for all to authenticated using (is\_admin()) with check (is\_admin());  
  
create policy books\_public\_read on books  
for select to anon, authenticated using (status = 'published');  
create policy books\_admin\_all on books  
for all to authenticated using (is\_admin()) with check (is\_admin());  
  
create policy settings\_public\_read on site\_settings  
for select to anon, authenticated using (true);  
create policy settings\_admin\_update on site\_settings  
for update to authenticated using (is\_admin()) with check (is\_admin());  
  
\-- Private operational data: admin only; anon has no policy and no grant.  
create policy subscribers\_admin on subscribers  
for all to authenticated using (is\_admin()) with check (is\_admin());  
create policy notifications\_admin on notifications  
for select to authenticated using (is\_admin());  
create policy deliveries\_admin on notification\_deliveries  
for select to authenticated using (is\_admin());  
create policy events\_admin on email\_events  
for select to authenticated using (is\_admin());  
\-- site\_admins: no policies. Only is\_admin() (security definer) reads it.  
  
revoke all on subscribers, notifications, notification\_deliveries,  
email\_events, site\_admins from anon;

6.1 Access summary
------------------

| **Table** | **anon** | **authenticated, not admin** | **authenticated admin** | **service role (server only)** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| posts, books | Select published | Select published | All | Not used |
| site\_settings | Select | Select | Select, update | Not used |
| site\_admins | None | None | None directly | Not used |
| subscribers | None | None | All | Insert/update in subscribe, confirm, unsubscribe, jobs, webhooks |
| notifications | None | None | Select (writes via functions) | Update status in jobs |
| notification\_deliveries | None | None | Select | Insert/update in jobs |
| email\_events | None | None | Select | Insert in webhook |

_The service-role key bypasses RLS, so it is used only in a small, reviewed set of server handlers and never in the browser. Tests assert that an anonymous client cannot read drafts or any subscriber data, and that a signed-in non-admin cannot either._

7\. Storage
===========

insert into storage.buckets (id, name, public, file\_size\_limit, allowed\_mime\_types)  
values ('media', 'media', true, 2097152,  
array\['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp'\]);  
  
create policy media\_admin\_write on storage.objects  
for all to authenticated  
using (bucket\_id = 'media' and public.is\_admin())  
with check (bucket\_id = 'media' and public.is\_admin());  
Files are read by public URL, so no read policy and no public listing is needed. Paths are covers/<book-id>/<random>.webp and about/<random>.webp; SVG is not allowed. Alt text lives in books.cover\_alt and site\_settings.about\_photo\_alt.

8\. Indexes and query patterns
==============================

\-- Home: newest published across all kinds  
create index posts\_home\_idx on posts (published\_at desc, id desc)  
where status = 'published';  
  
\-- Section index and previous/next within a kind  
create index posts\_kind\_idx on posts (kind, published\_at desc, id desc)  
where status = 'published';  
  
\-- Books page ordering  
create index books\_public\_idx on books (sort\_order, published\_at desc)  
where status = 'published';

| **Query** | **Shape** | **Served by** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Section page | where status = 'published' and kind = $1 and (published\_at, id) < ($2, $3) order by published\_at desc, id desc limit page + 1 | posts\_kind\_idx |
| Home recent | where status = 'published' order by published\_at desc, id desc limit 6 | posts\_home\_idx |
| Piece by slug | where kind = $1 and slug = $2 and status = 'published' | Unique (kind, slug) |
| Previous / next | Same as section page, direction reversed, limit 1 | posts\_kind\_idx |
| Notification recipients | insert into notification\_deliveries select id from subscribers where status = 'confirmed' on conflict do nothing | subscribers\_status\_idx |
| Unsent work for a job | where notification\_id = $1 and status <> 'sent' | deliveries\_pending\_idx |
| Confirm token lookup | where confirm\_token\_hash = $1 and confirm\_expires\_at > now() | subscribers\_confirm\_token\_idx |

Every list query must include the status = 'published' predicate even though RLS also filters, because the partial indexes only apply when the query repeats the predicate. Verify each with EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS) against seeded data before launch.

9\. Data lifecycle and privacy
==============================

| **Data** | **Kept for** | **Removed by** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Pending subscriber who never confirms | 30 days | Scheduled cleanup (Supabase pg\_cron or an equivalent daily job) deleting pending rows older than 30 days |
| Confirmed subscriber | Until they unsubscribe or are removed | Unsubscribe (status change) or admin erasure (row deleted) |
| Unsubscribed / bounced / complained | Kept to avoid re-mailing | Admin erasure on request |
| Delivery rows | 12 months, then summarised | Scheduled cleanup; counts kept on notifications |
| Email events | 90 days | Scheduled cleanup |
| Posts and books | Until deleted by the author | Author action; backups hold older copies per Supabase plan |

Personal data stored is only the subscriber’s email address and consent timestamps. No names, IP addresses or tracking identifiers are stored; rate limiting uses a short-lived hash held in Redis, not in Postgres. Retention periods above are proposals for the author to confirm against the privacy notice.

10\. Migrations and seed
========================

| **Order** | **Migration** | **Contents** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 001 | extensions\_and\_types | Section 3 |
| 002 | helpers\_and\_admins | Sections 4.1, 4.2 |
| 003 | content\_tables | Sections 4.3–4.5 with triggers |
| 004 | subscribers\_and\_outbox | Sections 4.6–4.8 |
| 005 | publish\_functions | Section 5 |
| 006 | rls\_and\_storage | Sections 6, 7 |
| 007 | indexes\_concurrently | Section 8 (separate migration; created concurrently on live data) |
| 008 | seed\_settings | Insert the single site\_settings row with placeholder \[Author Name\] to be replaced at handover |

Rules: each migration is reviewed with a rollback plan; no migration locks a table for long; destructive changes follow expand → backfill → contract across separate deploys. Seed content for local development and preview environments is synthetic and never contains real subscriber data.

11\. Requirement coverage check
===============================

| **Requirement** | **Schema support** |
| --- | --- |
| FR-LIST-01 (drafts never public) | posts\_public\_read and books\_public\_read policies |
| FR-READ-02 (poems keep line breaks) | body\_md stores raw text; poem rendering is a verse renderer keyed on kind |
| FR-QUOTE-01 | title optional only for quotes; 600-character check; optional attribution |
| FR-BOOK-01, FR-ADM-04 | books with progress, purchase\_url, cover\_alt rule |
| FR-SUB-01/02/03 | subscribers status machine, hashed confirm token with expiry, stateless unsubscribe token |
| FR-NTF-01/02 | publish\_post() plus unique keys on notifications |
| FR-NTF-03 | notification\_deliveries status and attempts |
| FR-ADM-01 | site\_admins, is\_admin(), RLS on every table |
| FR-ADM-06 | Alt-text checks and media bucket limits |
| FR-ADM-07 | Cascade deletes erase deliveries; admin policy on subscribers |
| NFR-REL-01 | Unique (notification\_id, subscriber\_id) |
| NFR-PRIV-01 | Minimal columns; no public policy on personal data; retention rules in section 9 |
